title: Build Christmas launches tomorrow - some new decorating footage
author: cozygridworks
selftext:
I shared Build Christmas here last month and wanted to show some new decorating footage before launch tomorrow, November 12. It started as a small project for my kids, and I've worked on it every week since.

It's a cozy North Pole city builder. You connect workshops into gift production chains, watch elves carry goods around town, and decorate before Christmas Eve. Each year brings a bigger delivery goal. There's a five-chapter story and a mystery about Santa.

For the 3D assets, I use reference images to settle the style, then have Claude Code or Codex build models through Blender Python scripts. The workflow checks them in the game and runs a separate critic pass. I review the results and send them through more passes when needed.

I think choosing a style the models can make consistently has helped a lot. When new models come out, I go back through the assets for another round of polish. Some of the bigger improvements led me to overhaul them.

I've worked hard on this and had fun learning about game design. It's harder than I thought to balance and tweak something so it stays fun for an extended period of time. I love city builders, so when I play through it I keep a voice note going and call out everything I'd expect to have as a player.

I'm at about 250 wishlists. For me, success is getting this far and launching tomorrow. I'm hoping for 5-10 players who enjoy it, give feedback and come back for updates :)

I hope a few people who are more creative than me go crazy in creative mode and build magical villages!

The AI work also includes coding, artwork, icons, written content and trailer narration. I review and refine the results before integrating them. I can answer questions about the game or how it came together.

It's $12.99 USD, with 15% off at launch through November 26.
